direction: David answers with quiet conviction: acknowledge the weapons, take a thought, then state his faith. Preserve the existing synthetic cast and every word. Listening acceptance remains with the owner.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: You come with sword and spear. I come in the name of the Lord, the God of the armies of Israel.

phrases.text: You come with sword and spear.
